FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 201
Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/12/2023
Senate Bill 201 as introduced could reduce potential insurance premium tax receipts to the State
General Fund by a small, undetermined amount dependent on the number of active-duty
members that purchase motor vehicle liability coverage in another state, pursuant to the
exemption provided by this bill.
